༄༅/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa nam mkha'i rdo rje rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa nam mkha'i rdo rje rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim mdor bstan pa/ /bla ma rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin lhan skyes 'gyur med dngos/ /bla ma'i zhabs la dang por 'dud/ /bde ba che dang gnyis med sbyor/ /shes rab pha rol phyin phyag 'tshal/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag /he ru ka dpal de la yang*/ / sor bcu spyi bor nges byas nas/ /bden pa gnyis kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can kun gyi 'od gsal ba/ /'di ni ye shes don dam ste/ /stong pa chen po rang ngo bo/ /nam mkha'i ri mo 'dzin pa'o/ /gang gi rang bzhin dag pa dngos kun khyab/ /nam mkha' 'di la mtha' dang dbus med bzhin/ /rang bzhin dag pa sangs rgyas sa bon 'di/ /'gro ba kun la ro mnyam gyur ba'o/ /skra shad lta bur rnam rtog gis nyon mongs/ /med par rtogs na 'dir gang 'ching mi 'gyur/ / rang bzhin dag pa'i de nyid yon tan bcas/ /mi rtog las kun mdzad 'di bsam yas te/ /'di la srid dang zhi ba'i bye brag med/ /de phyir yon tan thams cad 'di la yod/ /skyon bral chos rnams dag pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /de kho na 'di mkhas pas rig ces bya/ /rang bzhin sems 'di rgyu zhes bya ba ste/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar de las las kyi rlung*/ /de las 'od zer lnga dang yon tan 'byung*/ / de dag las kyang kun tu rgyu sogs rlung*/ /de mthar las kyi bag chags bgo byed de/ /rnam shes de bzhin yid dag dbang shes so/ /bag chags las kyi rlung dang yon tan las/ /bdag la chags sogs 'di na bskyed par byed/ /bag chags rnam par shes pa las rlung gis/ / dkrugs pas gzung 'dzin snang ba'i nges pas so/ /snying pos rdul dang mun pas snod kyi ni/ /'jig rten 'gro ba'i lus dang bcas pa bsgrub/ /de bzhin rnam par 'jig cing lus can gyi/ /rlung sogs gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin no/ /'dir gang rkyen bzhi bag chags dang snang ba/ /gang dag 'gags pa de 'dir rnam par rig

/de ltar rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dngos 'di ni/ /gzhi dang lam du gnyis min pa/ /mi 'phraugs dbye ba nyid la yang*/ /yon tan gsum gyis skye zhing 'jig /de yi 'od kyis khams gsum sgrub/ /khu rdul rlung gi tshogs phra ba/ /gnas skabs bzhi yi rang bzhin nyid/ /de ltar dag pa'i dngos 'di sbyong ba'i lam/ /'dir ni shes rab ye shes dpal dang ldan/ /'di ni rang bzhin 'od gsal rgyal ba'i rigs/ rang bzhin dag pas gsar du dag pa'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'pho ba med pa ste/ /bde chen 'dus ma byas dang de bzhin du/ /rang rig pa dang rnam pa thams cad pa/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i 'od gsal dam pa'i don/ /de ni bla ma'i zhal las rtogs bya ste/ dngos grub don du slob dpon bsten par bya/ /bla ma bsten tshul don dam bsnyen pa dang*/ /rgyud sde rnams dang lnga bcu pa sogs ltos/ /de nas slob dpon gyis ni thun mong dang*/ /thun mong min pa'i dbang bskur yang dag brtsam/ /rung bar bgyis pa'i sems ni 'di na dbang*/ /rdo rje slob dpon cho ga las la sogs/ /dam tshig ma nyams skabs bzhin bsrung ba yi/ /bu bzang de la lam yang bstan par bya/ /rgyud dang bla ma dag la yid ches pas/ /thog mar rgyud sde zab mo rnams thos nas/ /thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab dri med dang*/ /chos rnams rab tu 'byed pa dmigs med bcas/ /de mthar lam ni rnam gnyis yongs su brtag/ 'di dag chos la mos pa la sogs te/ /de phyir lam la mi 'phrod par 'dzin pa/ /de sogs sgrib pa bzhi yang don gyis bstan/ /sgrib pa'i gtso bo bag chags rnam bzhi ste/ /sad rmi gnyid stug bzhi pa zhes bya'o/ /so so'i nges pas lam yang nye tshe ni/ /zhi gnas mthar yang bskyed rim gtum mo dang*/ /phyag rgya'i lam las slob ma 'khrid par byed/ /phyi nas bzhi pa'i lam gyis bkri na mdzes/ /bzhi pa don dam shes rab ye shes ni/ /rtag tu khyab cing lam kun 'di na'o/

/bskyed rim bcos ma glo bur nye tshe ba/ /de yi 'bras bu dri bral khyab rtag ci/ /'di na bde ba dam pa rdzogs rim ste/ /sku bzhi'i dngos la reg par rgyal bas gsungs/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rang bzhin gang*/ /yongs su dag pa de yi lam yang 'di/ /dag par shes nas mnyam par bzhag gyur tam/ /dhū tī'i dbus su mi shigs thig le las/ /rnam kun 'od gsal sgrub par byed pa'am/ /gzhan du rgyud kyi rim pa zhes kyang bstan/ /nam mkha' yid dang mig dang rlung bcings pas/ /dpyid kyi sgrub byed dhū tīr gzugs mthong ste/ /du ba la sogs rnam bcur dngos kun rig /bsnyen pa'i yan lag mchog tu gsungs pa ste/ /rlung bcu dbu mar zhugs gnas thim pa'i tshul/ /rlung gi rang bzhin rdo rje gsum bzlas zhes/ /de bzhin gzhan las sa bon dang bral ba'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rim dang nor bu 'gengs/ /sngags kyi rim pa zhes kyang gsungs pa ste/ /srog rtsol bkag nas dbu mar 'bab pa gang*/ /'khor lo drug tu srog thur mnyam sbyor ba/ /'byung ba drug gi nyi zla'i bgrod pa 'gog /'di ni nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag go /sgyu ma'i dngos por chos kun bden pa ste/ /ye shes rim dang dza landha ra yi/ /rim pa mchog ces rgyud sde 'ga' las 'byung*/ /phyag rgya gsum las dbang po'i dbye ba yis/ /so so'i rim dang tha mar phyag rgya che/ /nor bur lhan skyes bde ba rang 'dod kyi/ /rnam bcu'i sgyu lus dbang po thams cad pa'o/ /'di ni sgrub pa'i yan lag de nas gzhan/ /snang gsum mthar yang dri med 'od gsal ba/ /gzung dang 'dzin par snang ba dag pa can/ /mngon byang chub ces dpal ldan 'dus par dang*/ /gzhan las bsam mi khyab dang gsang ba'i rim/ /las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgyar 'gog /de snyed mi 'gyur bde chen thob pa ste/ /gtsug tor mchog tu byang chub sems brtan pa/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i byed pa'o/

/'di ni bsgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste/ /dpal ldan ting 'dzin ces gang gsungs pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rba rlabs zhes pa'ang 'di kho na/ /'dzag bde'i dngos kyi gnyen po 'di yin no/ /'di ni dpal ldan phyag rgya chen po ste/ /rang byung ye shes mngon du byas pa yin/ /sems nyid gsal tsam rig las 'di khyad 'phags/ /ris med bde ba chen 'di rgyud sde'i don/ /deng sang gnas lugs phyag rgya cher grags pa/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo lugs sgom rim zhig /dbang po'i rim pas sngags dang go bstun pas/ /'gro ba rnams la sgron me lta bur gyur/ /lam 'bras pa yi snang gsum sogs dang mtshungs/ /bde stong phyag rgyar grags dang 'di mtshungs mod/ /'on kyang de ni cher yang lam bzhin bkri/ /de ltar de ni rnal 'byor pa yi lam/ /de nas spyod pa bya bar rgyal pas bshad/ /re shig gsangs te spyod pa bya ba ste/ /phyi nas a wa dhū tī'i spyod pa dang*/ /spros bcas la sogs phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi/ /spyod pa yin zhes chen po 'ga' zhig gsung*/ /la la shin tu spros med bhu su ku/ /spros med a wa dhū tī'i spyod pa dang*/ /brda' dang tshogs kyi rim pa rnam mang po/ /spros bcas ind+ra bhu tis mdzad pa ste/ /'dis na tshogs kyi 'khor lo dbang bskur zhes/ /gsungs te 'di gnyis 'gal ba yod ma yin/ /gnas 'dir phyag rgya chen po kho na'ang yod/ /shin tu spros med kun tu bzang po zhes/ / gsungs pa rnams kyang 'di la dgongs pa yin/ /'di ni grub pa rnams kyi lam yin te/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas rdzas kyi rig 'dzin dang*/ /las rgyas 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa grub/ /ye shes phyag rgyas gzugs khams phyag chen gyis/ /ye shes zung 'jug sku la snga nas sbyor/ /rnam kun ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ /nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa'o/ /de mthar thabs kyi tinga'adzin gyis/ /snying rje chen po bsgrub ces bya/ /stong dang brgyad brgya'i 'pho ba 'gog pa na/

/re re zhing yang sa ni thob par 'gyur/ /sa gsum gsum ni bsnyen pa la sogs te/ /ye shes sku chen sgrub par byed pas na'o/ /lus ngag thig le 'pho ba'i bag chags dang*/ yan lag bcu gnyis dus sbyor bcas pa bzlog /tha mal sgo gsum thig ler bcas bzlog pas/ /bde ba'i rdo rje rnam bzhi 'thob par 'gyur/ /yan lag rnam bzhi chos mos sogs sbyor bas/ /chos sku gtsang dang ye shes bde ba dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs sku 'dir yang dam pa'i bdag /sprul sku rtag pa dam pa 'bras bu bzhi/ /thabs dang shes rab dbye bas gzhi dang ni/ /lam du'ang rnam pa gnyis su bshad pa ste/ /de phyir ye shes sngags kyi sku rnam gnyis/ /bden gnyis ngo bo gcig pa rnam par rig /'di ni zung 'jug mi gnas myang 'das rim/ /gsang rim bsam mi khyab dang ting 'dzin 'bras/ /ye shes lus las tha mal ba la min/ /gzhom med sgra dang 'gyur bral bde chen thob/ /bde ba che dang rnam kun pa'i/ /yul gyi dbye bas ye shes sku/ /gzhom med nā da dang snying rjes/ /gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis su shes/ /ma rig bag chags sa dang yid kyi lus/ /mi shigs thig ler 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang*/ /gnas skabs bzhi dang rlung sems phra mo dang*/ /rlung dang rnam shes khu rdul tshogs pa dang*/ /don dam stong nyid de bzhin rnam kun pa/ /snang gsum rtsa rlung thig le 'od gsal dang*/ /zhu bde lhan skyes rang bzhin lhan skyes dang*/ /ye shes lus dang longs spyod rdzogs sku dang*/ /'pho med bde chen gzhom du med pa'i sgra/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin dang*/ /glo bur rnam dag de bzhin spyan lnga dang*/ /phyag rgya gsum dang dga' ba'i skad cig dang*/ /spyod pa gsum pa rnams dang dgu sogs dang*/ /bden don bcu gnyis de bzhin bcu drug gi /rnam pa'i rab dbye shes na gsang sngags kyi/ /nges pa'i don la da gzod spobs pa 'thob/ / 'di ni kun dga' snying po yis/

/rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa rnams/ /'gro la brtse ba'i sems grim pos/ /mdo tsam yongs su bshad pa yin/ /chos 'di'i ming ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa nam mkha'i rdo rje rab tu gsal ba zhes bya'o/ / shākya'i dge slong kun dga' snying pos bris pa'i dge bas rtag brtan g.yu drung dpal la gnas par gyur cig /dirghā yuḥ dza yantu/ rdo rje slob dpon thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /rab phye nam mkha'i rdo rje gsal ba'i gzhung*/ /'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /thos bsam bsgoms pas 'di don rtogs par shog /zhus dag/ shubha ma stu sarba dzā ga taṃ/ dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa nam mkha'i rdo rje rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 182 -- PAGE 183 - - PAGE 177 -
